items.docs: You can retrieve details about your own organisation
Provides a list of available organisation status (lookup).

info.name: Get list of active organization inclusive volumes

params.name: org_id_or_my
params.description: Numerical ID of an Organization or the string `my` to use the currently authorized organisation

items.docs:
Returns of a list of inclusive volumes that are currently active in the current billing period for the selected organisation.
This will not inclusive volumes that are already expired or have the start date set for a future billing period.

Only inclusive volumes for the own organisation or direct child organisations are accessible.

info.name: Assign a ratezone inclusive volume to an organization

params.name: org_id_or_my
params.description: Numerical ID of an Organization or the string `my` to use the currently authorized organisation

params.name: inclusive_volume_id
params.description:
Numerical ID of a ratezone inclusive volume.
Can be retrieved using `GET /api/v1/tariff/{tariff_id}/ratezone/{ratezone_id}/inclusive_volume`.

items.docs:
Assigns a pre-configured ratezone inclusive volume to the specified organization.

This can be done in self-service as well as for direct child organizations.
Only postpaid customers can assign
inclusive volumes in self-service, while parent organizations can assign inclusive volumes for both postpaid and prepaid child organizations.
The inclusive volume is charged and calculated against traffic charges accordingly in every bill
that is refreshed from that point on.

info.name: Monthly organization traffic and cost statistics

items.docs:
Retrieves traffic and cost statistics for the selected organization.

Traffic statistics accumulate for the `current_month` and `last_month` of the selected organization and all child organizations.
All other returned values (SIM statistics, user counts, etc.) are only for the selected organization.

info.name: Daily organization traffic and cost statistics

params.name: org_id_or_my
params.description: Numerical ID of an organization or the string `my` to use the currently authorized organization.

params.name: start_date
params.description:
Filters results to data collected on or after this date.
If `end_date` isn't specified, the response includes data through the end of the selected month.

params.name: end_date
params.description:
Filters results to data collected before this date.
Must be used with `start_date`.

items.docs:
Retrieves traffic and cost statistics for the selected organization and all child organizations, accumulated per day.

<Info>
  By default, this call returns statistics for the current month.
</Info>

params.name: org_id_or_my
params.description: Numerical ID of an organization or the string `my` to use the currently authorized organization.

params.name: start_date
params.description:
Filters results to data collected on or after this timestamp.
If not specified, the response includes data from the past three hours up to the current time.

params.name: end_date
params.description:
Filters results to data collected before this timestamp.
Must be used with `start_date`.
If not specified, defaults to one hour after the current time.

items.docs:
Retrieves traffic statistics for the selected organization and all child organizations, accumulated per hour.

<Info>
  By default, this call returns statistics for the last three hours.
</Info>

Allows an organisation to change their assigned tariff.

The following restrictions apply:
* The organisation must not have more than one tariff assigned.
* The tariff can be changed only for the own organisation and direct child organisations. The organisation status must be "ACTIVE".
* If performing the change in self-service, the organisation needs to be in evaluation. Parent organisations are allowed to change the tariffs of production organisations.

info.name: Organization usage and costs statistics per day for the current month

items.docs:
Retrieve usage and costs statistics for the currently logged in organization and all child organizations, accumulated per days from beginning of the month until today.

<Info>
  Data traffic costs aren't returned for enterprise organizations with inclusive volume.
</Info>
